brief: A base with a bay bin in one half of its cell.

requirements.requirement: A base with a bay bin in one half of its cell
requirements.evidence: Placed a Full hex base (piece:0,0,0;full) and added a half-cell bin (bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-half) that occupies one half of the cell. check_build: ok, meshClash clear, only info-level note that the six open faces could take caps. Interpretation caveat: I used the single-cell half bin. The catalog's 'bay' trays (addNotch) are a different part that must stand in an empty spot touching three cells, so they cannot sit on a lone base; I did not use one.

finish.summary: Built a full hex base with a half-cell bin in it. The configurator reports no errors and a clear mesh. I read 'bay bin' as the half-cell bin; the true bay tray needs three neighbouring cells and was not built.
